name: Sony Xperia 10 III (XQ-BT52)
_comment: Shipped device profile (docs/DEVICE-PROFILES.md). A key in your own override-hal.json replaces the same key here.
_why: On this port the camera driver dies at the first frame as soon as a RAW16 stream is in the session, on both cameras (tested 31 Oct 2026: JPEG 4000x3000 + preview ok; the same + RAW16 4032x3016 -> device error; camera 1: 3264x2448 ok, + RAW16 -> device error). JPEG and the viewfinder work. A stopgap: to be lifted when the RAW stream is understood (rawfish-ir-cli streamtest).
_match_note: By model only: the Xperia 10 II has the same sensor and RAW size (4032x3016) but its RAW stream works, so it must not get this profile.
